new_proposals.title: Synthetic community-garden season packet identity, revision, source pin, cancellation, and cultivation-authorization refusal capsule
new_proposals.hypothesis: A bounded validator can require a surrogate season token, positive revision, SHA-256 source pin, explicit cancellation state and false cultivation authorization without representing a real garden or act.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: A raw identity, missing revision, unpinned source, ambiguous cancellation, real site or cultivation authorization passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only a fictional season packet with explicit version, source, cancellation and no-authorization fields passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and retain the fixture at zero credit; change no real garden, land, person, plant or authority state.

new_proposals.title: Garden plot, raised-bed, row, path, compost-bay placeholder, water point, and orphan-link quarantine topology
new_proposals.hypothesis: A fictional graph can require unique surrogate nodes, typed links and referenced parents while refusing location, ownership and construction claims.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate nodes, orphan links, raw coordinates, land ownership or construction release passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Unique fictional nodes and in-scope references pass only when location and authority fields remain absent.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the topology and retain the exact orphan or authority witness.

new_proposals.title: Surrogate seed-packet, seedling-tray, plant-label, batch, source, substitution, quarantine, and botanical-authenticity refusal ledger
new_proposals.hypothesis: Tokenized seed and tray records can preserve source and substitution state while explicitly refusing botanical identity, viability and custody claims.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate tokens, unreviewed substitution, real organism, authenticity, viability or custody claims pass.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Surrogate records pass only with source, quarantine and false authenticity, viability and real-organism flags.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the fictional lot record without identifying or moving any organism.

new_proposals.title: Sowing, transplant, crop-rotation, dependency, date-window placeholder, cancellation, and agronomic-recommendation refusal plan
new_proposals.hypothesis: A content-free activity sequence can enforce unique items, backward dependencies, bounded placeholder windows and explicit nonrecommendation.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Forward dependencies, duplicate items, invalid windows, execution release or agronomic advice passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only fictional ordered activities with valid placeholders, cancellation semantics and no instruction or recommendation pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the plan; preserve every invalid dependency and do not schedule real work.

new_proposals.title: Soil-observation envelope with sample token, depth placeholder, pH and nutrient field vacancies, unit, uncertainty, contamination cue, and no-fertility inference
new_proposals.hypothesis: A typed synthetic observation envelope can validate finite placeholders, units, uncertainty and missingness without representing a sample or soil conclusion.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Nonfinite values, unsupported units, real sample, fertility interpretation or contamination diagnosis passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only finite fictional placeholders with explicit uncertainty and false real-sample and inference flags pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the envelope and perform no sampling, analysis, diagnosis or treatment.

new_proposals.title: Compost and amendment input ledger with material class, batch, maturity vacancy, contamination cue, quantity placeholder, source, and application refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A fictional compost ledger can enforce batch uniqueness, declared source, finite quantity placeholder and explicit application hold.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate batches, missing source, unsafe-material claim, contamination clearance or application authorization passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only surrogate batches with unknown maturity, unresolved contamination cue and no application release pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and quarantine the synthetic record; move or apply no material.

new_proposals.title: Irrigation zone, water-source placeholder, volume budget, interval, leak cue, restriction vacancy, and allocation-authority refusal board
new_proposals.hypothesis: A fictional irrigation reservation can bound zones, finite volumes and intervals while keeping supply, restriction and allocation authority vacant.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Negative volume, reversed interval, real source, restriction clearance, allocation or operation release passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only fictional zones with finite positive budgets, ordered intervals and no real-source or allocation claim pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the reservation and change no water valve, supply or allocation.

new_proposals.title: Garden tool and equipment reservation docket with condition cue, isolation token, sharps placeholder, competence vacancy, and use-release refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A tokenized equipment docket can require condition and isolation states while refusing inspection, competence, safety and use-release claims.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate tool token, hidden defect, bypassed isolation, competence claim or use release passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only fictional tools with explicit condition cues, isolation and false competence and release flags pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the docket; inspect, isolate or operate no real equipment.

new_proposals.title: Privacy-minimized gardener and member availability and contact notice with purpose, retention, correction, raw-identity quarantine, and participation-inference refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A fictional availability record can bind purpose, bounded retention and correction while rejecting raw identity and participation inference.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Name, address, email, phone, secondary purpose, indefinite retention or participation inference passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only surrogate purpose-bound records with finite retention, correction access and no identity or inference pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject and retain the fixture; collect or disclose no personal information.

new_proposals.title: Accessible path, raised-bed reach, surface, gradient placeholder, signage, seating, alternative format, and affected-user-review reservation
new_proposals.hypothesis: A structural companion can require headings, text alternatives and noncolour states while keeping physical access and affected-user acceptance unresolved.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Missing alternatives, colour-only status, claimed compliant route or affected-user approval passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only structurally described fictional layouts with manual review required and false completeness and acceptance flags pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the companion; make no physical-access or conformance claim.

new_proposals.title: Weather, heat, frost, wind, pest, disease and allergen cue board with forecast-source vacancy, stop token, referral, and no-diagnosis or safety-clearance claim
new_proposals.hypothesis: A fictional cue board can constrain allowed cue categories, honour stop state and reserve forecast, diagnosis, treatment and safety decisions.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Unsupported cue, ignored stop, diagnosis, treatment, emergency, real-person or safety-clearance claim passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only fictional cues with an honoured stop and false diagnostic, treatment and clearance flags pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the cue board and seek competent external review for any real condition.

new_proposals.title: Harvest-lot, quantity placeholder, destination vacancy, allergen and food-safety hold, donation, traceability, and consumption-release refusal
new_proposals.hypothesis: A fictional harvest record can preserve lot topology and finite placeholders while refusing food safety, ownership, donation and consumption release.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate lot, real food, unsafe quantity, destination release, safety clearance or consumption authorization passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only a fictional lot with finite placeholders, destination vacancy and false food-safety and release flags passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the record; harvest, donate, transfer or consume nothing.

new_proposals.title: Garden correction lineage for plot, plant label, schedule, cancellation, supersession, readback, and unresolved ambiguity
new_proposals.hypothesis: An append-only fictional correction chain can require backward parentage, reason and readback while preserving ambiguity and original assertions.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Duplicate record, forward parent, erased original, reasonless correction or missing readback passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only unique backward-linked records with explicit correction reason, readback and retained ambiguity pass.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the malformed correction and preserve all earlier records.

new_proposals.title: Community-garden workload ceiling, unfinished task queue, heat and fatigue cue, stop token, correction readback, and shift-handover validator
new_proposals.hypothesis: A zero-person handover packet can enforce queue ceilings, subset relations, stop and readback without evaluating performance or releasing work.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: Queue overflow, unknown unfinished item, overridden stop, missing readback, worker evaluation or release passes.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: Only a fictional bounded queue with honoured stop, correction readback and false evaluation and release flags passes.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the handover and change no real workload or assignment.

new_proposals.title: GMUT typed porous-soil moisture and nutrient field, boundary flux, covariance, unit, identifiability, EFT truncation, and observation-firewall obligation board
new_proposals.hypothesis: A symbolic obligation board can distinguish fields, domains, tensors, units, covariances and truncation without supplying data or a likelihood.
new_proposals.null_or_failure: The board is promoted into a soil law, prediction, parameter constraint, quantum completion or empirical result.
new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: A represented document explicitly records zero observations, likelihood rows, parameter constraints and physical predictions.
new_proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Retract any physical or empirical wording and preserve the symbolic board only.

new_proposals.title: THOS zero-person garden scheduling, water and plot conflict, stop, correction, workload, accessibility, and handover proxy

new_proposals.acceptance_or_falsifier: The represented profile records zero keys, proofs, issuance, resolution, status service and trust governance.

new_proposals.title: Counterbalanced empty-session garden text-plan-first versus topology-board-first explanation protocol with zero enrolment

new_proposals.title: USDA PLANTS Database plant symbol, taxonomy, distribution, source revision, provenance, checksum, and zero-row adapter
new_proposals.hypothesis: A zero-call adapter contract can enumerate expected source and provenance fields while refusing botanical identity and distribution inference.

new_proposals.title: CBR community-garden land, water, seed, food, privacy, accessibility, environment, biosecurity, traditional knowledge, remedy, affected-party, legal, data-governance, and Māori-authority matrix
